description: This source file defines the main activity and user interface composables for an Android TV streaming platform homepage. It includes layout for header navigation, hero banner, content sections with poster and channel cards, custom focus and accessibility handling, and image loading utilities.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity launching the streaming platform home screen.

methods.name: HomeScreen
methods.description: Main composable composing the homepage layout including header, banner, and content sections.

methods.name: HeaderBar
methods.description: Composable rendering the header with logo, navigation pills, search, and avatar.

methods.name: SearchIconGroup
methods.description: Composable creating a group of SVG images forming a search icon.

methods.name: FocusablePillText
methods.description: Interactive pill button that responds to focus and selection states.

methods.name: LogoGroup
methods.description: Component assembling the logo from multiple SVG pieces with relative positioning.

methods.name: SvgImage
methods.description: Wrapper for displaying an SVG image.

methods.name: SvgOrImage
methods.description: Loads and displays an image, preferring SVG with fallback.

methods.name: TvChannelCard
methods.description: Component representing a TV channel's card with image, overlay, play button, description, and tags.
